stem:
Rhea compares two packaged snacks using their nutrition labels.

Snack P: high calories, high fat, low protein, low dietary fibre.
Snack Q: fewer calories, lower fat, more protein, more dietary fibre.

Which claim correctly identifies the junk-food pattern?

options.text: Snack P better fits the junk-food pattern because it is high in calories and fat and low in protein and fibre.
Snack Q better fits the junk-food pattern because it has more protein and fibre.
Snack P cannot be junk food because it is sold in a packet.
Both snacks fit the junk-food pattern equally because both list calories.

teacher.key_rationale: Junk-food pattern on labels: high calories/fats with low protein and dietary fibre. Snack P matches; Snack Q does not.
